requirements.location: Complete outline sections1–9 and planned mechanism/financial exhibits.
requirements.basis: Read the full task and complete current outline. It preserves the2018–cutoff timeline and differentiates China, US, UK and Indonesia instead of projecting one market globally. The planned argument connects content supply, organic distribution, ad allocation and commerce while separating confirmed implementation from general principles and inference. Sections5–6 retain consent, identifiers, deduplication, attribution windows, refunds, organic baseline, incrementality and merchant contribution. Section8 explicitly considers macro, competition and subsidy explanations rather than inferring revenue causality from launch timing. The requested system/data-flow graphics, market comparison, timeline and brand/performance/commerce decisions all have concrete roles. This is adequate requirement coverage at outline stage, not a verification of still-unread financial or technical inputs.
